# Expert for
# SMB Resellers

## Webshop and Cloud

## ALSO has the right offer for you

Create holistic IT solutions with ALSO. Innovative applications from IoT to AI, from cybersecurity
to gaming. Sustainable processes and competent services. And all from a single source.

Learn more about our company, our strategy, and our approach towards sustainable IT.

* [Discover ALSO][89]

## Webshop for IT partners

### Intelligent IT Supply

[Two people in a warehouse looking at a tablet together]

Find everything you need for your customers' IT in our shop. And with our e-commerce services, you
can integrate the products directly into your own shop system. Or even easier, simply use
**myStore,** the white-label solution for your digital marketplace.

Buy smart. Sell smart.

* [Explore our webshop][90]

## Cloud

### Marketplace, Gaming Place, IoT, AI, Cybersecurity

[Two people in a datacenter discussing solutions ]

### From technology to solution

Our solutions stack runs deep.

Expand your business with Everything-as-a-Service (XaaS), cloud solutions with ALSO Cloud
Marketplace, and platforms for AI, IoT, virtualization, and cloud gaming.

And our value-added services support you with such complex issues as migrations, automation or
security concepts.

* [Explore our Cloud][91]

## Value Added Services

### Discover the services behind the technology

[Woman presenting statistics to a group of people in a meeting room]

### A partnership with ALSO positions your business at the center of an extensive ecosystem

Experience personalized service backed by teams of experts and a vast array of solutions such as

* Professional Services,
* Finance and Logistics Services,
* Premium Support,
* Cloud Management Services, and
* Migration Assessments.

We’ll keep you connected, competitive, and support your business across the digital landscape and
throughout the cloud.

* [Explore Value Added Services][92]

The same team of Microsoft experts, now within the comprehensive cybersecurity portfolio of
OpenText.

[Customer resources][96][FAQs][97]

**Unlock more value from Microsoft with OpenText Cybersecurity.**

[Explore Microsoft solutions][98]

## Important resources for customers

Although AppRiver is now formally part of the OpenText family, you still have access to the support
and account portals you're used to.

**[Secure Cloud Login][99]**

[**Support Portal**][100]** **(Zixcorp.com) 

## FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)

### What happened to AppRiver?

Quick history: AppRiver was acquired by Zix Corporation in 2019. Zix was then acquired by OpenText
in 2021. You've been directed to the OpenText Cybersecurity site, which represents the consolidated
product & service portfolios for AppRiver as well as our other products for data security and data
protection. 

### What's changed about my account team?

***Nothing. ***You'll still get the same great service and expertise that you're used to, just with
a new brand. (Tip: you should really check out our complete offering.)

### What's changed about managing my account?

***Nothing. ***We've simply consolidated the marketing aspects of the AppRiver website
within [https://cybersecurity.opentext.com][101], but the existing Secure Cloud portal has stayed in
place: [Secure Cloud Login][102]

### How do I contact support?

#### Encrypted Email Recipients:

Recipients of encrypted email who need assistance should contact the sending organization's support
group. This support contact information is provided on the portal login page.

#### ZixMail Non-Corporate Customers:

To open a ticket, please email [support@zixcorp.com][103]. Please allow up to 3 business hours for
email responses.

#### Corporate Customers:

Corporate customer administrators may contact us:
by phone (888-576-4949.),
by email ([support@zixcorp.com][104]), or 
via the [Support Portal][105] (Zixcorp.com).

# AppRiver is now part of OpenText™ Cybersecurity

The same team of Microsoft experts, now within the comprehensive cybersecurity portfolio of
OpenText.

[Customer resources][96][FAQs][97]

**Unlock more value from Microsoft with OpenText Cybersecurity.**

[Explore Microsoft solutions][98]

## Important resources for customers

Although AppRiver is now formally part of the OpenText family, you still have access to the support
and account portals you're used to.

**[Secure Cloud Login][99]**

[**Support Portal**][100]** **(Zixcorp.com) 

## FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)

### What happened to AppRiver?

Quick history: AppRiver was acquired by Zix Corporation in 2019. Zix was then acquired by OpenText
in 2021. You've been directed to the OpenText Cybersecurity site, which represents the consolidated
product & service portfolios for AppRiver as well as our other products for data security and data
protection. 

### What's changed about my account team?

***Nothing. ***You'll still get the same great service and expertise that you're used to, just with
a new brand. (Tip: you should really check out our complete offering.)

### What's changed about managing my account?

***Nothing. ***We've simply consolidated the marketing aspects of the AppRiver website
within [https://cybersecurity.opentext.com][101], but the existing Secure Cloud portal has stayed in
place: [Secure Cloud Login][102]

### How do I contact support?

#### Encrypted Email Recipients:

Recipients of encrypted email who need assistance should contact the sending organization's support
group. This support contact information is provided on the portal login page.

#### ZixMail Non-Corporate Customers:

To open a ticket, please email [support@zixcorp.com][103]. Please allow up to 3 business hours for
email responses.

#### Corporate Customers:

Corporate customer administrators may contact us:
by phone (888-576-4949.),
by email ([support@zixcorp.com][104]), or 
via the [Support Portal][105] (Zixcorp.com).

#### Archive, Encrypt and Protect Customers:

For non-urgent issues, please email [support@zixcorp.com][106]. We will respond to the email within
3 business hours. For urgent issues, email support or open a ticket via the support portal then call
support at 888-576-4949.

### How do I use the support portal?

When you arrive on our support portal, you can immediately access knowledge base articles for
questions about email encryption and how to open an encrypted email. You can also access ZixMail
user instructions and software downloads of ZixMail. Corporate administrators will need to login for
additional knowledgebase articles and software downloads related to ZixGateway and the management of
all Zix solutions.

### What training is available for administrators?

After deployment, we offer three Tech Talk webinars for additional assistance and refreshers. Please
login to the customer support portal to register for the webinars.Additionally, Zix has posted
training videos in the ZixGateway section of the support portal.

### Is there any cost to upgrade or maintain my software?

All patches, updates and new software releases for Zix are included in your service. There is no
cost to upgrade. We recommend the use of latest versions, which are available in the downloads
section of our support portal.

### I received an email notification stating I have received an encrypted email. What do I do next?

Recipients of encrypted email can get support from the sending organization. The support email
address can be found on the login screen when clicking on the encrypted email notification link. If
you have any questions about why you received an encrypted email notification or the content of the
message, please contact the sender.

## Our Purpose**Helping our customers change the world**

Our customers are some of the world’s greatest organisations. We work hard to get to know them,
understand their needs and put them at the heart of everything we do. We work relentlessly to build
their long-term trust, so they can rely on us in a complex and ever-changing world.

## Who we are

### Centred around our customers

Computacenter is a leading independent technology and services provider, trusted by large corporate
and public sector organisations. We are a responsible business that believes in sustainable
long-term value creation.

We build unrivalled value for our customers over the long-term, helping them to achieve their goals.
It’s one of the reasons that we’re trusted by some of the world’s greatest organisations.

commitment for Computacenter. We take a responsible approach across our operations including our
environmental impact, and we believe in delivering positive social impact within our communities,
too. These are enduring principles for us.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Core BTS, an NRI Group Company, is a full-service digital transformation consultancy that helps the world’s most impactful companies leverage today’s most powerful technologies to transform from the inside out. We simplify technical complexity, accelerate transformation, and drive business outcomes for our clients. Headquartered in Indianapolis, IN, we help organizations leverage cutting-edge technologies including AI, security, hybrid infrastructure, data, applications, modern work, and managed services. Our promise? Practicality: Our roots in infrastructure and cloud technology run deep, empowering us to navigate hybrid cloud environments with assurance. Simplicity: We simplify complex environments using proprietary tools that accelerate project discovery, connect disparate information, and automate manual processes. Our delivery framework provides a level of detail and pragmatism that’s second to none. Speed: Agility is our forte. We anticipate shifts in client needs and market trends and swiftly adapt. Our change management program minimizes business disruption, engages end-users, and accelerates time to value. Comprehensive Support: Our seasoned experts accompany you at every step of your digital journey, overcoming challenges as opportunities. From strategic planning through implementation and beyond, Core BTS is your unwavering ally. Trusted by companies of all sizes across all industries, we've earned our stripes through proven results and unwavering dedication. We're here to transform your vision into reality. Learn more at corebts.com.

## ** D&H Prioritizes Partners **

For more than a century, D&H has always put our partners first. To support their future growth, we
have recently expanded our dedicated sales & support teams, broadened our communities, grown our
solutions portfolio, and invested in our finance, supply chain, and marketing agency services.

**[Discover how D&H is Built for
Growth, Giving, and Generations >>][39]**

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

[Donate Here][41]

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

[Donate Here][42]

The family will be having a private funeral, however we also plan to host a Celebration of Life at a
future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

_crawl.about: EBTTIKAR, a subsidiary of N2V (Nano Nuance Venture), leverages a customer-centric approach, strategic partnerships, and continuous innovation to empower businesses with cost-effective IT solutions that drive long-term performance. We build trust through transparent communication, taking the time to understand each client's unique needs and tailoring solutions accordingly. In today's rapidly evolving market, EBTTIKAR is perfectly positioned to help businesses navigate the rise of managed and cloud services. By leveraging our expertise in Managed Services, Infrastructure, and Physical and Cyber Security Solutions, we enable businesses to optimize their IT infrastructure and unlock new levels of efficiency. EBTTIKAR places significant emphasis on Managed Services, Infrastructure and Physical and Cyber Security Solutions while striving to be at the forefront of embracing emerging technologies with a keen eye on trends like artificial intelligence (AI), Data Management and Video Analytics. EBTTIKAR has forged strong partnerships with international technology vendors, including Cisco, Huawei, HP, DellEMC, Amazon, Nutanix, Symantec and many more.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Exclusive Networks is a global trusted cybersecurity specialist for digital infrastructure helping to drive the transition to a totally trusted digital future for all people and organisations. Our distinctive approach to distribution gives partners more opportunity and more customer relevance. Our specialism is their strength – equipping them to capitalise on rapidly evolving technologies and transformative business models. The Exclusive story is a global one with a services-first ideology at its core, harnessing innovation and disruption to deliver partner value. With offices in 43 countries and the ability to service customers in over 170 countries across five continents, Exclusive combine the extreme focus and value of local independents with the scale and service delivery of a single worldwide distribution powerhouse. Join our team: www.exclusive-networks.com/about-exclusive-networks/careers/

ongoing support, you can choose exactly what you need to succeed.

into new areas.

# do together

## Giacom gives Technology Resellers and MSPs what they need to create brilliant solutions for their
## customers, from the world’s leading vendors and carriers.

[**Become a Partner**][87]
[**Why join us**][88]

## **Grow faster with Giacom**

**Access cloud, comms, hardware and software on our newly enhanced specialist marketplace designed
exclusively for the channel. Create bespoke offerings tailored to meet the needs of today’s SMBs,
all from one self-service platform.**

With an incredible selection of the best products, dedicated capabilities, outstanding value, and
ongoing support, you can choose exactly what you need to succeed.

**Watch our video** to see how you can grow faster with Giacom and explore everything we have to
offer you.

Cloud Market Platform

## Have the freedom of choice

Explore a digital marketplace that’s designed around you – with carefully curated products and
services specially selected for the SMB market. Gain exceptional value at scale, so you can expand
into new areas.

[Discover the Cloud Market platform][89]

## Cloud, chosen just for you

Always keep pace with changing cloud preferences and trends, with our selection of hand-picked
solutions and value added support. Bring your customers the best of cloud, faster.

[Discover cloud success][90]

## Comms without complexity

Expand your comms portfolio with simple, scalable connectivity solutions your customers will love.
We provide one place to buy and provision your selected services, with comprehensive lifecycle
support.

[Discover Business Mobile][91]
[Discover Business Broadband and Ethernet][92]
[Discover IP Communications][93]

## Hardware that adapts with you

Explore our varied and ever-evolving hardware portfolio, enabling you to always adapt and meet
changing customer needs while unlocking unique opportunities to expand your offering and customer
base.

[Discover leading hardware][94]

Support

## Be empowered by enablement

Your customers want a strategic technology partner with the breadth and depth of capabilities to
guide them to a more productive future. Our Partner enablement services can support your evolution
as a Managed Services Provider with:
* Learning and development
* Marketing resources
* Expertise and industry knowledge

[Grow your business][95]

Integrations

## Integrations and tools to streamline your business

Improve the accuracy and efficiency of your solution delivery, with our automated, end-to-end
software that’s built on a foundation of security. Our solutions can streamline your business across
sales, order management, billing, self-service and integrations.

Free up capacity and spend more time supporting customers.

[Discover flexible software][96]

People

## Technical support from people who get it

At every stage of your procurement journey, our dedicated, friendly people across sales, technical
and product teams are available to answer quick questions or provide good advice. As we manage
everything internally, you can also access second-line, end-to-end technical support across all
products from our fully trained team.

You can always rely on us for whatever you need.

Unlike other traditional distributors/VADs in the market we validate our technology choices by the people that make the buying decisions - end users. Ignition has a large community of enterprise end users that review and test new technology before we take it to channel. This is the only way to perform our due-diligence. Ignition is a channel only organisation.

de rutas.

El fabricante por lo general gasta un porcentaje significativo de su ingreso total en procesar
devoluciones. El ciclo de la cadena de distribución no termina necesariamente con la entrega de
productos en su destino final.

We provide dynamic and innovative technology products and solutions from software and cloud licences
to networking, data centre solutions, surveillance, data storage and cloud computing. Our services
consist of distribution, technical support, assembly, repairs and financing for our partner base.

With 35 years of experience, we have earned a solid understanding of the market challenges and
requirements. These insights allow us to offer a range of products and services in line with
shifting needs and trends. Our aim is to empower our partners’ businesses that they are able to
thrive and grow.

## We are flexible, client-focused and reliable

Our approach is to deliver service excellence, and to assist our partners in developing their
businesses. Our open-door policy and ‘can-do-entrepreneurial spirit’ makes us easy to work with. We
partner with tier 1 vendors to provide only the best solutions for the channel.
Based in South Africa, we have a broad national footprint and the ability to service resellers and
retailers across Southern Africa.

We have branches nationally across all provinces.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Prianto GmbH was founded in 2009 in Germany by William Geens and Oliver Roth as a starting point. Prianto is positioned in the distribution market as a pure play software distributor. Over the last years Prianto has grown into a group of companies covering the IT markets in Europe and Canada. Today Prianto is a leading software distributor with a focussed vendor portfolio. It is our mission to be a trusted partner for resellers, system integrators and Managed Service Providers and to market innovative software solutions that make digital infrastructures and corporate workplaces more efficient. Since 2011, Prianto has also been present in the UK, Austria and Switzerland, followed by the BeNeLux countries in 2012, Poland in 2014 and France in 2016. Branches were opened in 2017 in the Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia and the Adriatics. Since 2019 Prianto is also in Canada. We rely on absolute channel loyalty and sell only to IT resellers (VARs, system houses, integrators, Managed Service Providers, etc.). Our goal is to establish long-term, trustworthy and successful business relationships with reseller partners and international vendors. For this, we offer a high-margin and innovative software solutions, guaranteeing fast and well-founded software licensing services, as well as dedicated "Go-To-Market" strategies.

_crawl.linkedin_about: RAH Infotech enables enterprise technology adoption across cybersecurity, compliance, cloud, infrastructure and data centre modernisation through a curated ecosystem of leading OEM technologies, technical expertise and partner enablement. With more than two decades of experience, RAH works with OEMs, technology partners and enterprise-focused channel organisations to map the right solutions to the right business requirements. The focus is simple: help partners address complex customer needs with stronger solution design, sharper pre-sales support and greater delivery confidence. RAH’s portfolio spans network and perimeter security, endpoint and XDR, identity and access, data protection, cloud security, application security, SASE, security operations, GRC, infrastructure management, networking, cloud services and data centre build and management services. Beyond product access, RAH supports partners with technical guidance, solution mapping, implementation support, managed services capability and compliance-led expertise. This includes areas such as SOC, DPDPA readiness, VAPT, ISO management system services, infrastructure operations and data centre modernisation. In a market where technology stacks are becoming more fragmented, RAH helps bring structure to the ecosystem — connecting OEM innovation, partner reach and enterprise requirements into more resilient, governed and scalable technology outcomes. With 55+ security products, 100+ technical experts, 500+ enterprise customers and 750+ channel partners, RAH continues to support India’s enterprise technology ecosystem with depth, coverage and execution discipline.

It has a highly engaged, high-performing team and is certified as a Great Place to Work® in both Canada and the United States. Softchoice has also been recognized as a Best Workplace in Canada for more than 20 years. As part of WWT, Softchoice connects customers to the global scale, advanced innovation, world-class partnerships, and deep expertise of a leader in AI and digital transformation. _crawl.linkedin_about: TechnoBind Solutions Private Limited, a specialist technology distribution company has its headquarters in Bengaluru and presence at all major cities including Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai and Hyderabad. The channel centric, young and energetic company has its clear focus on the innovative offerings for Storage Solutions, Systems Management, Virtualisation and Cloud Management. The promoters bring unique values to the table from their decades of experience in Indian Channel business delivering technology solutions to the customers across all verticals. The management team at TechnoBind brings to the table a rich and varied experience across Enterprise Solutions, Ethical Sales, Channel Development and Capabilities in Technology Solutions. ## Who we are

Westcon-Comstor is a global technology distributor specialising in cybersecurity, networking, and
hybrid cloud solutions.

As growth architects of the channel, we connect technology from the world’s leading vendors with a
channel of IT partners, helping them seize opportunities and turn potential into growth.

 

 

##  

## Partner Success. It’s what we do.

Partner Success is our 40-year heritage of enabling vendors and partners to grow. With a
digital-first approach, data-driven processes, and trusted partnerships, we help partners create
future-proof businesses so they can proactively help their end-customers get the most from
technology and deliver Customer Success. 

[Partner_Success_banner_wide]

## PartnerCentral

### Our unified digital gateway for Partner Success.

PartnerCentral is our secure partner portal and digital platform, providing a single place for
everything you need to succeed in today’s IT channel.

[Find out more][29]

Partner with us to unlock commercial success through cutting-edge solutions, tailored to your needs.

[responsible-business-news-subscribe-card]

### Responsible Business

We take our responsibility seriously. Our strategy comprises three pillars: people, planet, and
communities.

[ Find out more ][32]

### Our specialist vendors

Our portfolio of specialist vendors includes global and early-stage companies offering
class-leading, proven technologies and the latest innovative solutions on the market. Our dedicated
teams ensure unrivalled product support and provide vendor-specific training and certification.

[ Check out our specialist vendors][33]

## Careers at Westcon-Comstor

Careers are more than just ‘jobs’ – they’re a journey. Whether you’re kickstarting your career or a
seasoned expert, our supportive environment will help you thrive.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

# EVORIM Excellent software

###### We develop software. Successfully.

###### Our software protects you, your privacy and your data.

###### Use our software and be amazed.

## Advanced Backup

Reliable and fast data backup

Advanced Backup is backup software that lets you professionally back up your important files and
drives. The program offers a variety of functions and settings. Scheduled or manual backups to all
common media with optional compression and encryption of your data.

[ Advanced Backup ][11]

## Free Firewall

Identify threats.
Protect privacy.

Free firewall is a full-featured professional firewall that protects against the threats of the
Internet. Control every program on your computer by permit or deny access to the Internet. Free
firewall notifies you when applications want to access the Internet in the background without your
knowledge.

[ Free Firewall ][12]

## HotkeyPro

Work faster. Increase productivity.

With HotkeyPro, you create hotkeys and keywords that allow you to automate various workflows and
actions. At the push of a button you can start programs, open folders or cathedral documents of any
kind, insert your own texts, simulate keystrokes and process scripts with which the range of
functions can be extended many times over..

[ HotkeyPro ][13]

## Cloudevo

Connect all your cloud storage together.

The software Cloudevo aggregates any number of cloud storage to a big united cloud. Cloudevo
combines all of the different cloud services to one large cloud. This united Cloud is then mounted
as a drive on your device. All files are encrypted securely on the Cloud drive.

[ Cloudevo ][14]

# Keep your sites online 24/7

Whether you are a residential installer, a commercial integrator for businesses, the IT department
of a multi-site organization, or even a regional ISP serving thousands of customers, Keenetic's
remote monitoring and management system is here to make your job easier. Stay ahead of the
competition with Keenetic mesh Wi-Fi routers.
* Commercial and residential integrators
* Corporate IT departments
* Regional ISPs

residential integrators]

## Commercial and residential integrators

Keenetic offers an ideal remote monitoring and management system that enables both commercial and
residential integrators to effectively monitor and fully manage their customers' networks,
significantly reducing on-site visits. With Keenetic RMM, you can save valuable resources and
streamline operations, resulting in increased efficiency and cost savings.

[Corporate IT departments] [Corporate IT departments] [Corporate IT departments]

## Corporate IT departments

Keenetic's remote monitoring and management system allows organizations to easily scale their IT
infrastructure as their needs evolve. It enables efficient management of multiple sites in different
geographical locations, improves operational efficiency, reduces costs, enhances security and
enables proactive problem resolution, resulting in a more robust IT environment.

[Regional ISPs] [Regional ISPs] [Regional ISPs]

## Regional ISPs

Keenetic enables regional ISPs to deliver superior service to their subscribers by providing stable,
high-speed connectivity, minimising outages and service interruptions, and helping to resolve
customer queries, concerns and technical issues quickly and effectively. Stay competitive in a
fast-moving market, reduce customer churn and improve customer satisfaction with Keenetic's remote
monitoring and management solution.
* In [GetWiFi Lda.][13] we use RMM that empowers our administrators by providing real-time status
  updates for all remote site routers, offering a convenient solution for executing bulk operations
  to reduce management time. The cloud-based controller contains essential data for daily monitoring
  and receiving critical emergency notifications, ensuring the delivery of top-notch customer
  service. This comprehensive solution not only enhances efficiency but also accelerates reaction
  times to effectively address problems.
  
  Sergio Nesma, GetWiFi LDA, Portugal Project Manager

## Works with any Keenetic device

Keenetic offers a wide range of mesh Wi-Fi routers for Ethernet, Fibre, DSL and 4G Internet
connectivity. Additional Keenetic devices can be installed in mesh Extender Mode to further increase
Wi-Fi coverage. Regardless of the Internet connection technology and number of extenders, the entire
site is fully remotely managed at no extra cost.

## Fail-safe remote management

Theodore Roosevelt's words ring true: “The only man who never makes a mistake is the man who never
does anything.” That's why Keenetic goes the extra mile to provide a fail-safe configuration mode
for remote management that protects against accidental loss of control over a remote site. This
exceptional feature gives you unparalleled peace of mind when using Keenetic's remote monitoring and
management system.

connected client devices remotely]

## Manage connected client devices remotely

The Keenetic solution allows you to manage not only the remote site itself, but also the client
devices connected to the remote site with simplicity and efficiency. With a single click you can
securely connect to lighting systems, control systems, network switches, IP cameras, network video
recorders, network attached storage, printers and anything else that supports web access (HTTP,
HTTPS). No public IP address or additional firewall configuration is required.

recorders, network attached storage, printers and anything else that supports web access (HTTP,

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

_crawl.about: Econnet, founded in 2009 by a group of young entrepreneurs with previous experience in the IT distribution and Information & Communication Technology sectors, is a distributor specialized in Networking, Cyber Security, Unified Communications & Collaboration, Storage & BackUp solutions that stands out for the contribution of concrete added value to the proposed solutions. Choosing Econnet means: Being able to count on a catalog of carefully selected products based on the manufacturer's innovation and professionalism criteria. Econnet searches and selects brands and partners that stand out for reliably supporting continuously evolving Information Technology. Having turnkey solutions capable of supporting real technological growth of businesses. Take advantage of various initiatives aimed at training such as collective and individual courses (including certification), themed seminars, traveling roadshows. Guaranteed availability of proactive and prepared pre- and post-sales support. The Econnet staff boasts certifications and strong technical and commercial skills, both in the pre-sales and post-sales fields. A pool of certified technicians makes technical assistance one of the company's strengths. To date, Econnet has a staff of around 15 people, including employees, consultants and sales agents, capable of covering the entire national territory. The registered office, operational headquarters and warehouse are in Bologna, while a commercial office is located in Milan and two home offices are located in Catania and Chieti. There are approximately 870 active customers throughout the national territory and the Republic of San Marino, of which approximately 270 are certified in the VoIP field and more than 130 are certified in the Cyber Security field.

_crawl.linkedin_about: We are Newark, part of Farnell Global, the fast and reliable distributor of products and technology for electronic and industrial system design, maintenance, and repair. From research and design through prototype to production, we are here to help you access the products and services you need 24/7. With more than 80 years of experience, 48 localized websites, and a dedicated team of over 3,300 employees, we provide every component you need to build the technology of tomorrow. Farnell Global trades as Newark in the Americas, Farnell in Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Japan, and element14 across Asia Pacific. It also sells direct to consumers through its CPC business in the UK. We have been part of the established global technology distributor, Avnet, since 2016. Today, this relationship allows us to support our customers at every stage of the product life cycle, offering a truly unique distribution model, as well as expertise in end-to-end delivery and product design. For more information, visit: https://bit.ly/44I8osr Stay up-to-date with us across: Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/newarkelectronics Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/Newark_Avnet Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/newark_electronics Community: www.community.element14.com

_crawl.about: Indian Society for Quality (ISQ) was established in 1996 as a Not-for-Profit Society with the objective of providing a national forum for interaction among quality professionals. The society acts as a catalyst and facilitation body for exchange of information and experience regarding Quality management principles, technology and practices. Its mission is to pursue quality for prosperity. Towards its objectives, ISQ has instituted many awards to recognize outstanding contributions by industry leaders, business professionals, TQM promoters in quality bodies and TQM counsellors who have selflessly contributed to the quality movement in India through their leadership and knowledge. As a member of Asian Network for Quality (ANQ) involved from the very outset and represented on its Board, ISQ is the face of India overseas in the world of quality. ISQ hosted the 2nd ANQ Congress in 2004 in New Delhi as well as the 2010 ANQ Congress at Noida in which 800 participants, including 170 from overseas participated and 214 papers were presented. ISQ continues to represent India actively in ANQ Congresses. It also maintains the ANQ website cooperation with member organizations from various Asian countries. The flagship event of ISQ is its Annual Conference where awards are presented, and illustrious speakers from India and overseas are invited. ISQ also reaches out to its constituents through a variety of open training programs and seminars from time to time. One of the prestigious program conducted in 2018 was Jishu Kotei Kanketsu (JKK) by senior leaders from Toyota, and attended by CEOs as well as quality assurance professionals. Membership of ISQ is open to individual professionals from all fields: academia, consulting, manufacturing and service organizations, besides government, education, healthcare and NGOs.

## FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)

### What happened to AppRiver?

Quick history: AppRiver was acquired by Zix Corporation in 2019. Zix was then acquired by OpenText
in 2021. You've been directed to the OpenText Cybersecurity site, which represents the consolidated
product & service portfolios for AppRiver as well as our other products for data security and data
protection. 

### What's changed about my account team?

***Nothing. ***You'll still get the same great service and expertise that you're used to, just with
a new brand. (Tip: you should really check out our complete offering.)

### What's changed about managing my account?

***Nothing. ***We've simply consolidated the marketing aspects of the AppRiver website
within [https://cybersecurity.opentext.com][101], but the existing Secure Cloud portal has stayed in
place: [Secure Cloud Login][102]

### How do I contact support?

#### Encrypted Email Recipients:

Recipients of encrypted email who need assistance should contact the sending organization's support
group. This support contact information is provided on the portal login page.

#### ZixMail Non-Corporate Customers:

To open a ticket, please email [support@zixcorp.com][103]. Please allow up to 3 business hours for
email responses.

#### Corporate Customers:

Corporate customer administrators may contact us:
by phone (888-576-4949.),
by email ([support@zixcorp.com][104]), or

#### Archive, Encrypt and Protect Customers:

For non-urgent issues, please email [support@zixcorp.com][106]. We will respond to the email within
3 business hours. For urgent issues, email support or open a ticket via the support portal then call
support at 888-576-4949.

### How do I use the support portal?

When you arrive on our support portal, you can immediately access knowledge base articles for
questions about email encryption and how to open an encrypted email. You can also access ZixMail
user instructions and software downloads of ZixMail. Corporate administrators will need to login for
additional knowledgebase articles and software downloads related to ZixGateway and the management of
all Zix solutions.

### What training is available for administrators?

After deployment, we offer three Tech Talk webinars for additional assistance and refreshers. Please
login to the customer support portal to register for the webinars.Additionally, Zix has posted
training videos in the ZixGateway section of the support portal.

### Is there any cost to upgrade or maintain my software?

All patches, updates and new software releases for Zix are included in your service. There is no
cost to upgrade. We recommend the use of latest versions, which are available in the downloads
section of our support portal.

### I received an email notification stating I have received an encrypted email. What do I do next?

Recipients of encrypted email can get support from the sending organization. The support email
address can be found on the login screen when clicking on the encrypted email notification link. If
you have any questions about why you received an encrypted email notification or the content of the
message, please contact the sender.

Seamlessly secure identities throughout the cycle of accessing any resource across any

most.

#### Seamless & secure access for all identities

By combining secure SSO, Adaptive MFA, Lifecycle Management, Directory Services and User Behavior
Analytics, we help you streamline operations and give users simple and secure access to
resources—on-premises, cloud, hybrid—from any location, using any device.


#### Intelligent privilege controls

Apply world-class intelligent privilege controls across the IT estate, as well as differentiated
controls to secure the unique needs of workforce users, third-party vendors, endpoints and machine
identities as they access sensitive data.


#### Flexible identity automation & orchestration

Streamline HR processes, ensure users have the right access to the right resources, enable
compliance with industry or government regulations, and improve efficiencies across the board with
orchestration and lifecycle management, permissions and entitlements, and directory and federation
services.

### Identity Security Defined

Centered on intelligent privilege controls, identity security seamlessly secures access for all
identities and flexibly automates the identity lifecycle with continuous threat detection and
prevention — all with a unified approach.

partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.

[**Why join us**][88]

**Access cloud, comms, hardware and software on our newly enhanced specialist marketplace designed
exclusively for the channel. Create bespoke offerings tailored to meet the needs of today’s SMBs,
all from one self-service platform.**

With an incredible selection of the best products, dedicated capabilities, outstanding value, and
ongoing support, you can choose exactly what you need to succeed.

**Watch our video** to see how you can grow faster with Giacom and explore everything we have to
offer you.

Cloud Market Platform

## Have the freedom of choice

Explore a digital marketplace that’s designed around you – with carefully curated products and
services specially selected for the SMB market. Gain exceptional value at scale, so you can expand
into new areas.

[Discover the Cloud Market platform][89]

## Cloud, chosen just for you

Always keep pace with changing cloud preferences and trends, with our selection of hand-picked
solutions and value added support. Bring your customers the best of cloud, faster.

[Discover cloud success][90]

Expand your comms portfolio with simple, scalable connectivity solutions your customers will love.
We provide one place to buy and provision your selected services, with comprehensive lifecycle
support.

## Hardware that adapts with you

changing customer needs while unlocking unique opportunities to expand your offering and customer
base.

[Discover leading hardware][94]

Support

Your customers want a strategic technology partner with the breadth and depth of capabilities to
guide them to a more productive future. Our Partner enablement services can support your evolution
as a Managed Services Provider with:

* Expertise and industry knowledge

Integrations

## Integrations and tools to streamline your business

Improve the accuracy and efficiency of your solution delivery, with our automated, end-to-end
software that’s built on a foundation of security. Our solutions can streamline your business across
sales, order management, billing, self-service and integrations.

Free up capacity and spend more time supporting customers.

[Discover flexible software][96]

People

and product teams are available to answer quick questions or provide good advice. As we manage

products from our fully trained team.

You can always rely on us for whatever you need.

###### Fabricantes

Somos la mejor opción para las principales marcas, que depositan su confianza en nuestro amplio
conocimiento de la industria para expandir su alcance en la región.

[Ver Más][43]

###### Retailers

Transforma la experiencia del cliente en el punto de venta.

[Ver Más][44]

###### Canales de valor agregado

Los clientes son la fuerza que impulsa a nuestra organización. El crecimiento de nuestros clientes
es nuestro principal objetivo.

[Ver Más][45]

###### Operadores

Para los operadores líderes en telecomunicaciones, el hecho de mantenerse enfocados en su propio
negocio jamás debería ser un desafío.

[Ver Más][46]
+14
Contamos con una presencia local basada en una red propia de 14 subsidiarias.
+50000
Atendemos a más de 50 mil canales de distribución.
+180
Fabricantes con un portafolio de más de 12.000 productos.
100000
Metros cuadrados de capacidad en 24 puntos de almacenamiento y distribución.

### Almacenamiento

Potencializa la demanda regional en localizaciones estratégicas a través de nuestro inventario de
disponibilidad inmediata especialmente concebido para garantizar la reposición y entrega expedita de
productos.

### Selección, empaque, flete y facturación

Intcomex dispone de un procedimiento flexible de selección, empaque y despacho con el fin de
preparar todo tipo de pedidos, sin importar su complejidad.

### Servicios de aduana e importación

La complejidad del comercio internacional jamás debe limitar la magnitud de tu participación en el
mercado.

### Seguimiento de pedidos


Gracias a nuestro sistema de gestión y seguimiento, es posible conocer el estatus de pedidos en cada
etapa del proceso de envío hasta que estos sean recibidos en su destino en perfectas condiciones y
en la fecha programada.

### Distribución local de mercancía


Nos encargamos de entregar tu producto donde lo necesites, a tiempo y dentro de tu presupuesto.
Contamos con una cadena de distribución fiable basada en una red de transporte y en la optimización
de rutas.

### Logística inversa


El fabricante por lo general gasta un porcentaje significativo de su ingreso total en procesar
devoluciones. El ciclo de la cadena de distribución no termina necesariamente con la entrega de
productos en su destino final.

services, and value-added support to its resellers and partners. Trusted Partnerships By maintaining

diverse product portfolio, value-added services, and industry-leading logistics capabilities will
enable it to provide its resellers and partners with comprehensive technology solutions tailored to
their needs.

# Beyond ICT

We provide dynamic and innovative technology products and solutions from software and cloud licences
to networking, data centre solutions, surveillance, data storage and cloud computing. Our services
consist of distribution, technical support, assembly, repairs and financing for our partner base.

With 35 years of experience, we have earned a solid understanding of the market challenges and
requirements. These insights allow us to offer a range of products and services in line with
shifting needs and trends. Our aim is to empower our partners’ businesses that they are able to
thrive and grow.

## We are flexible, client-focused and reliable

Our approach is to deliver service excellence, and to assist our partners in developing their
businesses. Our open-door policy and ‘can-do-entrepreneurial spirit’ makes us easy to work with. We
partner with tier 1 vendors to provide only the best solutions for the channel.
Based in South Africa, we have a broad national footprint and the ability to service resellers and
retailers across Southern Africa.

We have branches nationally across all provinces.

# Ras Infotech India is Value Added Distributor for Cyber Security Solutions

Your one stop security solutions provider with expertise. As a security expert, our solutions cover
the security aspects required throughout the life cycle of data from the creation to the disposal of
the hardware containing it. With that said, our channel network of over 200 active enterprise
partners/resellers cater to over a 1000 enterprise accounts throughout the region of India. And to
continue addressing the ever-increasing sophistication of the threats faced by organizations in this
day and age, we too continue to expand our expertise and bring in new and even more sophisticated
information security solutions into the market.

[ More About Us ][91]

### Network Access Control (NAC)

NAC supports practical security compliance by providing real-time network surveillance for all the
assets.

### OT ENDPOINT PROTECTION

Endpoint security protects devices from cyber threats with tools like antivirus, firewalls, and
intrusion detection systems.

# Bringing people and
# technology together

Tarsus Distribution is an innovator in Africa's technology supply chain, partnering with the world's
leading IT vendors and the continent's top value-added resellers and systems integrators to deliver
customer-centric solutions.

[Get In Touch][81]
[About Us ][82]
[Technology Solutions ][83]
[Technology Partners ][84]

# Leading the Industry

Our very own Emile Burger CA (SA) has made the cover of ITWeb Brainstorm South Africa, the country’s
leading B2B technology magazine — a publication read by thousands of senior technology
decision-makers and C-suite leaders every month.
[Read More ][85]

## Technology Solutions
* [Accessories][86] →
  
  ### Accessories
  
  Accessories enhance the experience devices deliver. Tarsus Distribution has partnered with
  world-leading accessory brands to bring you only the best.
  
  [Read More [accessories]][87]
* [Compute][88] →
  
  ### Compute
  
  The modern world is built on the processing power of millions of computing solutions. Tarsus
  Distribution prides itself on partnering with leading computing companies.
  
  [Read More [accessories]][89]
* [Cybersecurity][90] →
  
  ### Cybersecurity
  
  We offer full end-to-end cybersecurity solutions, giving clients a holistic, centralised and
  one-stop solution to protecting their data, networks, and devices. With our list of trusted
  cybersecurity partners, you are in good hands.
  
  [Read More [cybersecurity]][91]
* [Display][92] →
  
  ### Display
  
  The quality of monitors and displays has improved greatly. We’ve partnered with world-leading
  display solutions partners, bringing you a wide range of high-quality products for your customers.
  
  [Read More [display]][93]
* [Energy][94] →
  
  ### Energy
  
  Energy is the backbone of connectivity in a connected world. To ensure that your business never
  loses its supply, look to energy solutions from Tarsus Distribution.
  
  [Read More [display]][95]
* [Hyperconvergence][96] →
  
  ### Hyperconvergence
  
  We help clients simplify their data centre operations with hyperconvergence. Tarsus Distribution
  has been supplying IT components for the past three decades, keeping our fingers firmly on the
  pulse of this sector.
  
  [Read More [hyperconvergence]][97]
* [Networking][98] →
  
  ### Networking
  
  The foundation of any modern business is its networking capabilities. Tarsus Distribution supplies
  high-quality networking solutions across southern Africa. Our network specialists are up to date
  with the latest technological development within this field.
  
  [Read More [networking]][99]
* [Print][100] →
  
  ### Print
  
  Tarsus Distribution has been supplying consumer and enterprise print solutions for many years. We
  identify the print demands of each group and supply a range of high quality and cost-effective
  printers that meet their needs.
  
  [Read More [print]][101]
* [Servers][102] →
  
  ### Servers
  
  Tarsus Distribution provides a wide range of server solutions for all purposes and organisations.
  We work closely with resellers to source and supply the best technology for any purpose from
  leading IT brands.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# BunkerWeb, the open-source and next generation web application firewall (WAF)

## Make your web services secure by default

Fool attackers and protect your web services with our open-source Web Application Firewall.
BunkerWeb acting as a shield in front of your web services, it blocks attacks before they can hit
and guarantees condidentiality, integrity and availability of your data.

[ Read the doc ][27]
[ 1min Video ][28]

## Web security without any hassle

Placed as a reverse proxy while offering Web Application Firewall (WAF) functionalities, the
BunkerWeb solution integrates seamlessly into your existing infrastructure to secure your web
services.

BunkerWeb will help you defend against common web threats such as those listed in the OWASP Top 10,
block malicious bots, mitigate DDoS attacks and much more…

Use the solution as a single entry point for your web services and easily manage your HTTPS
certificates, incoming traffic from external sources, and security policies related to the HTTP
protocol. In other words, the security of your websites, applications and APIs is no longer a
hassle.
* Seamless integration into your existing infrastructure
* Reverse proxy with built-in security features
* Open-source solution auditable by a third party
* Fully configurable to meet your needs

### Integrations

More info on how to install BunkerWeb on Linux, Docker and Kubernetes in [our documentation][29]

[ Github repository ][30]
[ Join our discord ][31]

### AGPLv3 free license

## An open-source solution

Distributed under the AGPLv3 free license, the solution’s core code is entirely auditable by a third
party and the community. Unlike the opaque “black boxes” available on the market, we’ve made the
choice of transparency and peer validation. In other words, we advocate for open security over
security through obscurity. Do not choose the shadows anymore, discover the light.

Why Choose Open Source?
* **Total Transparency:** accessible source code ensures maximum trust and security
* **Active Community:** benefit from global collaboration with users worldwide
* **Sovereignty:** keep control and ownership of your data
* **Customization:** tailor the software to meet your project’s specific needs

Do not choose the shadows anymore, discover the light.

[ Github repository ][32]
[ Plugins list ][33]
Our Vision

### Transparency

BunkerWeb places transparency at the core of its solution, allowing users access to clear, open
code. This approach ensures uncompromised security and offers full visibility into every protective
mechanism in place.
Our mission

### Auditability

BunkerWeb’s auditability enables users to verify and assess the security measures applied. By
providing open access to code and configurations, BunkerWeb facilitates regular audits, enhancing
compliance and trust.

# Welcome to Channel Dive

It’s a new day for tech channel news at Industry Dive and Informa TechTarget.

Published Oct. 30, 2025
[ [Phil Harvey's headshot] ][27]
[Phil Harvey][28] Editor-in-Chief

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

## Security breaks when firewall policy breaks.

Enterprises don’t lack cybersecurity tools. They lack control.

Policies are scattered across firewalls, clouds, and segmentation tools, creating blind spots,
drift, and compliance gaps that attackers exploit.

#### FireMon brings it back together.

## How we stop policy from undermining security:

[Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud][Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud]

### Firewall Policy Management from Ground to Cloud

FireMon serves as the system of record for network security policy. It normalizes and governs
firewall rules across on-prem and cloud environments, giving teams a single place to manage policy
for safer and controlled change.

What We Do

## Our Main Services

### [Wi-Fi Services][13]

Wi-Fi networks, which use a growing variety of wireless devices, must be handled very carefully.
Whether it is 10 Access Points or 1,000 Access Points; for the planning, security and operation of
all wireless network solutions required for your business; As IDEUS, we support you.

### [Training Center][14]

IDEUS provides high quality vendor approved IT technical classroom training, online training and
certification courses designed to give our partners essential knowledge needed to be successful. We
are one of Palo Alto Networks’ “Authorized Training Partner” and also “Authorized Training Center”
of HPE Aruba.

### [Assessments][15]

IDEUS provides comprehensive assessments to determine the current state of your security posture.
Our assessments are designed to address vulnerabilities, and provide recommendations for improvement
to optimize your security, mitigate risk, and enable your organization.

### [Implementation][16]

IDEUS engineers implement solutions that are proven, tested and reliable. Before deployment, our
engineers thoroughly verify and test designs to ensure that it meets all of the objectives
established in the design phase. The result of a network implemented by iDeus is a solution that is
worthy of your trust.

### [Network Security][17]

Network Security – The impact of data network security breaches can range from minor to very
significant. Setting up the right prevention measures is critical to stopping unauthorized users
from gaining access to your network. IT security solutions consulting services go beyond just border
firewalls; they include intrusion detection and hardening of your network infrastructure.

### [Consultancy][18]

Consultancy– A consultant will help analyze your network and ensure your systems are working
effectively. Get help managing all the details; including routing and switching needs, data center,
software defined networking and management. Ensure your network is running smoothly so you can focus
on delivering quality products and/or services to your customers.

## Источников всё больше — а времени читать их нет

Источников вакансий всё больше: HH, LinkedIn, Хабр Карьера, десятки сайтов. А ещё — сотни
телеграм-каналов рекрутеров, где вакансии появляются первыми и которых часто нет на job-сайтах.
Уследить за всем этим вручную невозможно.

В итоге вы подписаны на десятки каналов — но не открывали их неделями и не знаете, что уже
пропустили. Лучшие вакансии всё чаще живут не на HH, а в телеграм-каналах — и появляются там раньше.

Whether you are a residential installer, a commercial integrator for businesses, the IT department

Stay informed and receive timely notifications of critical site events with real-time alerts
delivered via Telegram messenger. We also actively monitor security-related events and notify you

## Team management

monitoring and management system. Each team member can have their own individual login, enabling
scalability and reducing risk by implementing two-factor authentication (2FA) or single sign-on

labels, you can easily view and manage the sites or nodes that are most relevant to your needs.

navigation. Clicking on any of the visual graphs in the dashboard creates a dynamic filter, allowing

threats while delivering the highest levels of availability. We put this commitment ahead of

triage incoming change requests, monitoring alerts and incidents as well as incoming calls to ensure
all events are prioritized according to their urgency and properly handled.

## Native, Managed SASE is Better

Most Managed SASE offerings are cobbled together from several leading vendors by service providers
who create a portal to make them appear as a unified single SASE solution.

**Open Systems is different.**

We offer a unique comprehensive, native and managed SASE network transformation solution with a
focus on providing a delightful customer experience. Enjoy simple, secure connectivity and robust
security. Come. Explore our platform...

## Native, Managed SASE is Better

Most Managed SASE offerings are cobbled together from several leading vendors by service providers
who create a portal to make them appear as a unified single SASE solution.

**Open Systems is different.**

We offer a unique comprehensive, native and managed SASE network transformation solution with a
focus on providing a delightful customer experience. Enjoy simple, secure connectivity and robust
security. Come. Explore our platform...

**What is Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)**

Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) is a term coined by Gartner that combines security and network
functions into a unified cloud-based service, simplifying the management of complex networks while
providing protection against a wide range of cyber threats. SASE is particularly relevant for
organizations that are moving toward cloud-based applications as a service, and that have a
distributed workforce or branch offices. It offers a more agile and secure approach to network and
security management.

How I Work

## A four-phase engagement, built for production reality

I don't hand over a report and leave. I work alongside your team through the full arc — from
understanding what you actually run, to operating it safely.

01 / Assess

### Assess

Discovery of your current network, firewall policy base and exposure. A risk baseline grounded in
what's really deployed — not assumptions.

02 / Architect

### Architect

A target design and phased roadmap with a clear business case. Topology, segmentation, HA and the
order to get there without downtime.

03 / Deploy

### Deploy

Hands-on implementation with change windows, rollback plans and production safety. I configure,
validate and document as we go.

04 / Operate

### Operate

Tuning, monitoring and knowledge transfer. Either I hand a running system to your team, or PJ
Networks runs it as a managed service.

Consulting Services

## What I'm brought in to fix, design and defend

Eight focused practices. Each engagement is scoped to your environment — below is the depth you can
expect across scope, deliverables and the stack I work in.

SVC-01

### Network Architecture & Design

Design the network so security is structural, not bolted on.

#### Scope
* Campus, datacentre and multi-site WAN topology design
* Routing & switching architecture, VLAN and segmentation strategy
* High availability: active-active firewall clusters, VRRP, redundant uplinks
* Capacity and growth modelling for AI / high-density workloads

#### What you get
* Reference architecture, topology diagrams and IP/VLAN plan
* HA failover design, bill of materials and phased migration runbook

**Stack:** FortiGate · Cisco Catalyst/Nexus · FortiSwitch · SD-WAN · BGP/OSPF · VRRP
SVC-02

### Zero-Trust Architecture

Verify every user, device and flow — no implicit trust inside the perimeter.

#### Scope
* Identity-driven access policy and device posture (NAC)
* Micro-segmentation and application-layer enforcement
* VPN-less remote access (ZTNA) for hybrid workforces
* Rollout sequencing that won't break production traffic

#### What you get
* Zero-trust policy model and identity/posture integration design
* Segmentation map and a staged, reversible cutover plan

**Stack:** FortiAuthenticator · FortiClient ZTNA · FortiNAC · Security Fabric · SAML/RADIUS
SVC-03

### Firewall Engineering & Optimization

Get more security and throughput from the firewalls you already own.

#### Scope
* Policy rationalisation, rule cleanup and shadow-rule removal
* IPS / SSL-inspection / UTM profile tuning for real workloads
* FortiAnalyzer & syslog log-pipeline alignment and gap closure
* Firmware lifecycle planning and full rule-base audit

#### What you get
* Audited, deduplicated policy base and inspection baselines
* Logging pipeline that captures what matters, plus a performance report

**Stack:** FortiOS 6.2–7.4+ · FortiManager · FortiAnalyzer · IPS/AV/WF · Syslog/NetFlow
SVC-04

Stand up the eyes-on-glass that catches problems before users do.

* NOC/SOC tooling, process and on-call model design
* SIEM / SOAR pipeline and detection engineering (ATT&CK-aligned)
* Alert triage, correlation and escalation runbooks

## A four-phase engagement, built for production reality

I don't hand over a report and leave. I work alongside your team through the full arc — from
understanding what you actually run, to operating it safely.

01 / Assess

### Assess

Discovery of your current network, firewall policy base and exposure. A risk baseline grounded in
what's really deployed — not assumptions.

02 / Architect

### Architect

A target design and phased roadmap with a clear business case. Topology, segmentation, HA and the
order to get there without downtime.

03 / Deploy

### Deploy

Hands-on implementation with change windows, rollback plans and production safety. I configure,
validate and document as we go.

04 / Operate

### Operate

Tuning, monitoring and knowledge transfer. Either I hand a running system to your team, or PJ
Networks runs it as a managed service.

Consulting Services

## What I'm brought in to fix, design and defend

Eight focused practices. Each engagement is scoped to your environment — below is the depth you can
expect across scope, deliverables and the stack I work in.

SVC-01

### Network Architecture & Design

Design the network so security is structural, not bolted on.

#### Scope
* Campus, datacentre and multi-site WAN topology design
* Routing & switching architecture, VLAN and segmentation strategy
* High availability: active-active firewall clusters, VRRP, redundant uplinks
* Capacity and growth modelling for AI / high-density workloads

#### What you get
* Reference architecture, topology diagrams and IP/VLAN plan
* HA failover design, bill of materials and phased migration runbook

**Stack:** FortiGate · Cisco Catalyst/Nexus · FortiSwitch · SD-WAN · BGP/OSPF · VRRP
SVC-02

### Zero-Trust Architecture

Verify every user, device and flow — no implicit trust inside the perimeter.

#### Scope
* Identity-driven access policy and device posture (NAC)
* Micro-segmentation and application-layer enforcement
* VPN-less remote access (ZTNA) for hybrid workforces
* Rollout sequencing that won't break production traffic

#### What you get
* Zero-trust policy model and identity/posture integration design
* Segmentation map and a staged, reversible cutover plan

SVC-03

Get more security and throughput from the firewalls you already own.

#### Scope
* Policy rationalisation, rule cleanup and shadow-rule removal
* IPS / SSL-inspection / UTM profile tuning for real workloads
* FortiAnalyzer & syslog log-pipeline alignment and gap closure
* Firmware lifecycle planning and full rule-base audit

#### What you get
* Audited, deduplicated policy base and inspection baselines
* Logging pipeline that captures what matters, plus a performance report

**Stack:** FortiOS 6.2–7.4+ · FortiManager · FortiAnalyzer · IPS/AV/WF · Syslog/NetFlow
SVC-04

### NOC / SOC Design & Managed Detection

Stand up the eyes-on-glass that catches problems before users do.

#### Scope
* NOC/SOC tooling, process and on-call model design
* SIEM / SOAR pipeline and detection engineering (ATT&CK-aligned)
* Alert triage, correlation and escalation runbooks
* 24/7 monitoring model and SLA framework

#### What you get
* Detection content mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and SOAR playbooks
* Escalation model, operational dashboards and SLA reporting

**Stack:** SIEM/SOAR · Elasticsearch · MITRE ATT&CK · EDR/XDR · Threat-intel feeds
SVC-05

### Assessment, Audit & Compliance

Know where you stand — and what Indian regulators expect of you.

#### Scope
* Architecture and configuration review against best practice
* Vulnerability assessment and prioritised remediation
* Gap analysis against Indian regulatory frameworks
* Audit-readiness and evidence preparation

#### What you get
* Findings ranked by business risk, mapped to controls and owners
* Remediation roadmap with effort estimates and a compliance evidence pack

**Frameworks:** CERT-In · DPDP Act 2023 · RBI IT Framework · SEBI CSCRF · ISO 27001-aligned
SVC-06

### Incident Response & Threat Hunting

When something's already inside, contain it — and learn from it.

#### Scope
* IR readiness, playbooks and contact-tree design
* Live containment, eradication and recovery support
* Forensic log analysis and root-cause reconstruction
* Proactive hunting for fileless, C2 and lateral-movement activity

#### What you get
* IR plan, containment actions and a root-cause timeline
* Hardening recommendations and an executive debrief

**Stack:** EDR/XDR · YARA · JA3 / C2 beacon detection · Packet capture/DPI · Log forensics
SVC-07

Reliable connectivity at every site, with security built into the edge.

* Wi-Fi 6E design, RF planning and AP placement

* Branch failover across multiple ISPs / circuits

* RF / AP plan, SSID and segmentation design
* SD-WAN underlay/overlay policy design and branch runbook

## Your network is a black box.

Without the network, you can't trace threats across your environment.
And right now, your network is an empty space.

### Traffic is everywhere. End-to-end visibility is nowhere.

### Incident response turns into manual mapping.

[Port0]

## See Everything.
## Install Nothing.

Port0 analyzes complete network and identity context from the tools you already have. So you get the
visibility of a network sensor, without the hardware, tap, or SPAN port.

Discover

Correlate

Detect

detect anomalies faster.

Alert when attackers pivot between systems. See the full attack path before they reach critical
assets.

Real-time alerts for suspicious activity. Your network is monitored around the clock.

### Maintain Compliance

Continuous monitoring and audit trails support SOC 2, ISO27001, and HIPAA requirements.

### Investigate Faster

AI-powered analysis surfaces relevant context automatically. Trace connections across weeks of
activity in minutes instead of hours.

solutions, and online privacy tools.

real-world usage scenarios. We aim to provide balanced information that helps readers understand
both the advantages and limitations of different tools, without relying on exaggerated claims or
unnecessary complexity.

are beginners or more advanced users.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

# The simple way to manage and support multi-unit restaurant, retail, and hospitality technology for
# emerging brands.

With SpecGravity, Multiunit brands gain a dedicated 24/7 tech support department for NSO and ongoing
support to keep their locations running, troubleshoot issues, and to monitor and remediate issues
before they arise.

## How can IT support help support your hospitality, restaurant, or retail brand?

### [Hospitality][25]

Fast Casual to Full Service and Hotel, we help open new stores , support existing, and manage all
your technology across the brand.

[Learn More][26]

### [Retail][27]

Boutique to Big Box, we’ve got you covered. New Store Openings, 24/7 Support, National Dispatch, and
Project work, we do it all.

[Learn More][28]

### [Nationwide Dispatch][29]

Chances are, your IT staff shouldn’t fly across the country to troubleshoot a broken printer; that’s
where we come in.

[Learn More][30]

### [Office Tech Support][31]

In a remote world, your Home Office and Field staff need the same level of support your stores do.
Let us cover their tech issues 24/7

[Learn More][32]

### [Cybersecurity][33]

The Anti-Virus that comes with your laptops isn’t enough. You need to layer in AI, Continuous
Monitoring, and Proactive Remediation.

[Learn More][34]

### [National Rollout Projects][35]

POS Rollouts, Digital Menu Boards, Network Upgrades, and beyond, our nation wide team manages your
project, from end to end.

[Learn More][36]
